# node-qrcode provenance — DAILY-039

Reviewed 2026-11-04. Chinese browser-local wrapper; this is not the upstream full application. Reuses the reviewed 2026-10-30 LAB generation bundle, with a newly implemented and newly tested main-site page. No claim that this mature library is newly released or recently active.

- Upstream: https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode
- Fixed qrcode version: **1.5.4**; v1.5.4 tag object `5d87b5f1a333ffb402dc0754a3f5f58f8fca2299`, commit `3848ed2c17de5bcdead487417dbf14c5dd017f8d`. Existing LAB tag proof and registry gitHead match.
- Original npm artifact: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode/-/qrcode-1.5.4.tgz ; lock integrity `sha512-1ca71Zgiu6ORjHqFBDpnSMTR2ReToX4l1Au1VFLyVeBTFavzQnv5JxMFr3ukHVKpSrSA2MCk0lNJSykjUfz7Zg==`. This integration does not claim a fresh archive download/signature validation.
- Actual browser file `qrcode.js` SHA256 **c3eda770798c027c0f91b6eccb65043af50b8fcff6029f628b8ea964e260a14a**. Original published package did not contain the README-promised browser build. This is a locally packed 28-module browser artifact from `qrcode/lib/browser.js` and `dijkstrajs@1.0.3`. This integration independently reran the read/rewrite-only local packer logic against existing installed source; its bytes exactly match the fixed LAB bundle. No package build/lifecycle scripts executed, no install, no main lock change. Module paths and individual hashes retained in `.cache/node-qrcode-audit/modules.json` outside public assets.
- Actual README, qrcode/dijkstrajs package scripts and original licenses read again. qrcode is MIT (Ryan Day); original `LICENSE-qrcode.txt` SHA256 `8df47c6ad9ac2c41eb9b2a72def9908959da0ede8dadd56c7b249c1bdb0c5ce6`. dijkstrajs is MIT (Wyatt Baldwin), original `LICENSE-dijkstrajs.txt` SHA256 `c46324e45a005413535a6fb7a97e9eacd3cc6bf30335b7d5c10b8ee3af9e60c2`. Bundle retains the original qrcode/Kazuhiko Arase and dijkstrajs copyright/license comments plus license notices.
- Browser dependency graph: qrcode1.5.4 core/renderers and dijkstrajs1.0.3 only. No fonts, images, CDN, workers, remote fetches, tracking or API. URLs in bundle are documentation/license comments or SVG namespace. Source scan found no fetch/XMLHttpRequest/eval/new Function.
- qrcode package additionally declares pngjs^5.0.0 and yargs^15.3.1 for Node/CLI paths; they and yargs transitives are absent from the browser graph and not shipped here. Original full installation tree remains LAB evidence. Development scripts: lint standard, pretest lint, test node test.js, build rollup, prepublish build, browser example server. dijkstrajs pretest jshint/test mocha. No install/postinstall hooks in either package. No such scripts run in this integration.
- Original README notes ECI support is incomplete. UTF-8 Byte content can decode differently in some readers; no universal Chinese scanner guarantee. No optional Shift-JIS table included.
- Wrapper restricts UTF-8 bytes≤1200, QR version≤27, module size≥4 pixels, sizes256/384/512/768, margin4/6/8 and ECC L/M/Q/H. Black/white only. It does not open encoded URLs. Dense data is refused and stale outputs removed.

Historical LAB failures and tests remain historical: the version39/400-Chinese/H density example had failed independent readback, which is why the wrapper refuses versions above27. This integration does not fix or reclassify that failure. Current main-site PNG and rasterized SVG were newly independently decoded by the previously reviewed external ZXing-C++2.3.0 acceptance tool; that decoder is not shipped here or counted as a website project. Real devices and printing remain untested. Full current evidence: `docs/tasks/DAILY_QR.md`.
